title: Valve 开放 Steam Frame 候补名单，起售价 1059 美元
content:
Valve opens waiting list for Steam Frame, starting at $1059 | GamesIndustry.biz
If you click on a link and make a purchase we may receive a small commission.
Read our editorial policy
.
Valve has opened a waiting list for its new VR system, Steam Frame.
There are two models available - the 256GB and a 1TB headset - both of which sport 4 nm Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 - ARM64, 16GB of RAM, and come with two controllers and Half-Life: Alyx included. Neither ships with a power supply.
The cheaper model will cost $1,059 (£889), while the 1TB model is on sale for $1,299 (£1089).
Here's the full specs:
256GB Headset
4 nm Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 - ARM64
16GB Unified LPDDR5X RAM
256GB UFS storage, microSD card slot
Rechargeable 21.6 Wh Li-ion battery
2160 x 2160 LCD (per eye)
72-144Hz refresh rate (144Hz experimental)
Inside-out camera based tracking
Wi-Fi 7, 2x2 - wireless adapter included
Bluetooth 5.4
Dual speaker drivers per ear, dual microphone array
SteamOS 3
Steam Frame Controllers – full 6-DOF and gamepad controls
Half-Life: Alyx included
Note: Power Supply not included
1TB Headset
4 nm Snapdragon® 8 Gen 3 - ARM64
16GB Unified LPDDR5X RAM
1TB UFS storage, microSD card slot
Rechargeable 21.6 Wh Li-ion battery
2160 x 2160 LCD (per eye)
72-144Hz refresh rate (144Hz experimental)
Inside-out camera based tracking
Wi-Fi 7, 2x2 - wireless adapter included
Bluetooth 5.4
Dual speaker drivers per ear, dual microphone array
SteamOS 3
Steam Frame Controllers – full 6-DOF and gamepad controls
Half-Life: Alyx included
Note: Power Supply not included
Valve announced three new hardware products
- the Steam Frame VR headset and controllers, a new Steam controller, and a next-gen Steam Machine - last year. Its new wireless VR headset, Steam Frame,
will support Android games
as it uses the same Android APKs developers already use to port mobile titles to Android-based devices like Meta Quest.
News of Valve's new VR system comes on the back of notable
VR developer, Polyarc Games, shutting down after 12 years in operation
.
